incidents.name: APC TransSwap spot-price swap
incidents.notes: The TransSwap proxy priced APC against MUSD from the APC pair's live reserves, so a flash loan pumped APC, swapped it into MUSD at the inflated rate and swapped back once the price had been dumped.

sources.ref: onchain review: TransSwap proxy 0x5a88114F02bfFb04a9A13a776f592547B3080237 created 2022-11-24T20:50:51Z by 0x0f8470262ac99e91751b26e37aae4ebf1e666666, unrelated to attack sender 0xc578d755cd56255d3ff6e92e1b6371ba945e3984; the single EIP-1967 Upgraded event is the one emitted at construction, so the age is the deployment age. Loss verified onchain: 44,077.14 USDT left 0x3de032d5d11c94d2d79dba0c34d7851ffaa05dd8 and the attacker netted 40,477.14 USDT in the first of the two attack transactions. Boundary row: the swap contract behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
